title: Reasoning is not working - Amazon Bedrock Anthropic

linked_prs.title: fix(provider/bedrock): Fix Reasoning - Amazon Bedrock Anthropic

## Background

The Bedrock provider was sending `reasoningConfig` in the request body when reasoning was enabled, but according to [the Bedrock API documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/claude-messages-extended-thinking.html#claude-messages-use-extended-thinking), the correct field name should be `thinking`. This caused "Extra inputs are not permitted" errors when using reasoning capabilities with Bedrock models. (#6617)

## Summary

- **Fixed field name transformation**: Changed `reasoningConfig` to `thinking` in `additionalModelRequestFields` when reasoning is enabled
- **Added filtering logic**: Prevented `reasoningConfig` from being accidentally sent at the top level by filtering it out from `providerOptions.bedrock`
- **Updated comments**: Changed code comments to reflect the correct field name (`thinking` instead of `reasoningConfig`)
- **Added comprehensive tests**: Added tests for both `doGenerate` and `doStream` to verify the transformation works correctly


## Verification

**Manual Testing**. Verified againsts the following examples, which are failing in `master` branch.
